title: A new perspective on endometriosis: Integrating eQTL mendelian randomization with transcriptomics and single-cell data analyses.

claims.exposure_source: Peripheral blood eQTL via IEU OpenGWAS (Westra 2013 cited)

first.source_location: Results/Discussion text (direction); estimates only in Fig. 2C; Fig. 3 forest plots (unreadable at available resolution) and supplementary CSV
first.notes: Direction from text; numeric estimate not extractable from main text. IVs at P<5e-8, r2<0.001, 10,000 kb clumping, F>10 (no cis window stated). Significance: IVW p<0.05, consistent direction, no pleiotropy; no multiple-testing correction. Gene is one of 30 MR hits intersecting DEGs; 24 other intersecting genes appear only in figures and the full MR hit list only in supplements (not extracted). Controls figure (231,771) equals total N in GWAS Catalog. GCST90018839 is Sakaue 2021; IEU N=231,771 European (FinnGen+UKB meta); GWAS Catalog entry also lists BBJ/East Asian samples, so verify cohort set.

second.source_location: ESM 4 (10142_2025_1543_MOESM4_ESM.csv, table.MRresult); forest plot Fig. 2C/3
second.outcome_source: IEU OpenGWAS ebi-a-GCST90018839 (GWAS Catalog GCST90018839)
second.notes: eqtl-a IEU exposure (text cites Westra 2013). P<5e-8, clump 10,000 kb, trans SNPs included. 231,771 given as controls. Abstract: 'novel biomarker genes'; aim 'new genetic targets'.
